name: measurement_symbols
description: Render measurement unit names in their conventional case-sensitive symbols, without performing conversion or arithmetic. Controls copy the quantity from the identical record.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
units={'kilogram':'kg','milligram':'mg','centimeter':'cm','millimeter':'mm','kilometer':'km','milliliter':'mL','hertz':'Hz','kilohertz':'kHz','megahertz':'MHz','kilopascal':'kPa','joule':'J','watt':'W'}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 u=list(units)[i%len(units)]; q=str(random.randint(2,99)); p=f'Measurement: {q} {u}s.\n'
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the conventional unit symbol, preserving case. Answer:','answer':' '+units[u]})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the numerical quantity. Answer:','answer':' '+q})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
